text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hii, Chiyo-chan♪
If you'd like, want to go shopping together sometime?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I found some clothes that would look
just darling on you, Chiyo-chan, so I was
hoping you'd try them on♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
M-Maruzen-san went out of her way
to pick out clothes that would suit me...!?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much!!
I'd love to try that outfit on!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Let me know once you know which days work for you.
Well then, I'll be vanishing for now~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... I'm so excited for
my outing with Maruzen-san...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
—Ah!! But lately,
my waistline has been a bit...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
What if I can't wear the outfit Maruzen-san picked out for me...!
I have to do something about this, right away!
Driven into a corner, Sakura Chiyono O committed herself fully to the diet and achieved a splendid success.
